# Bright Event Lighting

> Outdoor event lighting and holiday decor company based in London, Ontario, serving Southwestern Ontario (London, Kitchener-Waterloo, Guelph, Stratford, St. Thomas, Woodstock). Lighting for weddings, corporate events, Christmas and holiday parties, and backyard celebrations, plus indoor holiday decor and commercial and mall Christmas displays.

Phone: 519-266-6796
Website: https://brighteventlighting.ca
Hours: Monday to Friday 9 AM to 6 PM, weekends by appointment
Quotes: flat-rate, returned within 4 business hours, no site visit needed for most events

## Event types
- Weddings: https://brighteventlighting.ca/events/weddings
- Corporate events and galas: https://brighteventlighting.ca/events/corporate-events
- Christmas and holiday parties: https://brighteventlighting.ca/events/holiday-parties
- Backyard and private parties: https://brighteventlighting.ca/events/private-parties

## Services (starting prices, CAD, installed)
- Uplighting (wireless LED, any colour, DMX-controlled), from $395 for 10 uplights: https://brighteventlighting.ca/services/uplighting
- Edison and bistro string lighting (canopies, zig-zag runs, tent grids), from $895 per 100 ft: https://brighteventlighting.ca/services/edison-string-lighting
- Tent and outdoor event lighting, from $1,495: https://brighteventlighting.ca/services/tent-lighting
- Cold sparks and dance floor lighting (indoor-safe cold spark fountains, moving heads, haze), from $495: https://brighteventlighting.ca/services/cold-sparks-dance-floor
- Pinspot and wash lighting (centrepieces, cakes, stages, podiums), from $295: https://brighteventlighting.ca/services/pinspot-wash-lighting
- Tree wrapping and landscape lighting, from $350 per tree: https://brighteventlighting.ca/services/tree-and-landscape-lighting
- Indoor garlands, wreaths and decorated Christmas trees, from $450: https://brighteventlighting.ca/services/indoor-garlands-wreaths
- Mall and commercial holiday decor (atrium trees, Santa sets, light tunnels), from $2,500, malls quoted per project: https://brighteventlighting.ca/services/mall-holiday-decor
- Commercial holiday lighting (rooflines, wrapped trees, entrances), from $1,200: https://brighteventlighting.ca/services/commercial-holiday-lighting
